preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S <= 10**16 for S in Ss)
preconditions.description: Maximum possible sum of weights S is between 1 and 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in vs)
preconditions.description: Vertex v_i is within the range of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n for u_i in us)
preconditions.description: Vertex u_i is within the range of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**6 for w_i in ws)
preconditions.description: Weight of each edge w_i is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i in [1, 2] for c_i in cs)
preconditions.description: Cost of each edge c_i is either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output is an integer representing the minimum total cost.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[i] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(w(root, v) for v in leaves) <= S for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf is at most S.
